title: Solar system
description: A low-poly sun, eight planets, an asteroid belt and two comets. Each planet's name arches over it and a band of facts circles it, written right into the 3D scene. A slow tour visits one planet at a time. Hover or tap one to pick it yourself, and its details type out. The belt is computed from time alone, so it stays exact at any orbit speed.
line: Planets wrapped in their own facts. Tap one and its details type out.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
